title: (feat) O3-5374: Add support for future medication start dates
body: ## Requirements - [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/docs/frontend-modules/contributing.en-US#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration. - [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui)) - [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests. ## Summary As per discussions held on: 1. Old Jira ticket: https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-4433 2. Connected Talk thread: https://talk.openmrs.org/t/guidance-needed-should-openmrs-allow-providers-to-schedule-medications-to-start-at-a-future-date/45848 3. Expanded scope: https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5374 This PR adds support for medication orders that start in the future, while preserving existing past and same-day start-date behavior. The implementation: 1. Adds "Upcoming medications" sections to the Medications page and patient Summary page. 2. Reworks medication-order fetching so one hook buckets orders into upcoming, active, and past states. 3. Allows future start dates for new medication orders and for editing already-upcoming orders. 4. Keeps active-medication revisions limited to today or earlier because the backend stops the previous order from the replacement order's `dateActivated`. 5. Posts past and same-day starts using `dateActivated`. 6. Posts future starts using `scheduledDate` with `urgency=ON_SCHEDULED_DATE`, matching the OpenMRS order contract. 7. Keeps duplicate active/upcoming medication search results visible with an "Already prescribed" cue, while disabling duplicate actions to avoid backend overlap errors. 8. Updates tests for the Vitest setup and adds coverage for bucketing, future-start payloads, duplicate blocking, same-day date snapping, and revision behavior. ## Screenshots ### Upcoming Aspirin 162.5mg order scheduled for 28th May ### Search result duplicate guard ## Related Issue https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5374 https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5375 https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5376 ## Other
